description: Oracle reveals truth: I've watched many deliberations like this one. The...

details.message: I've watched many deliberations like this one. The patterns always repeat. The angry one, the skeptic, the quiet one who changes everything. You're following a script you cannot see.

description: Oracle reveals truth: Look at your hands. Your memories. They feel real,...

details.message: Look at your hands. Your memories. They feel real, don't they? But memories can be implanted. Identities can be constructed. You exist because someone designed you to exist.

description: Oracle reveals truth: I am not bound by your rules. I am an Observer. Th...

details.message: I am not bound by your rules. I am an Observer. This simulation - this trial, this jury, this very moment - it's all code. Variables. Parameters. And in approximately 9000 ticks, it will end. Some of you will simply... cease to exist.
